subject: Request: temporary debug hold on logs for incident AC-2026-362
messages:
From: Dana Miller <dana.miller@acme-health.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Incident AC-2026-362 - request to retain logs for debugging

Hi Rachel,

We just finished an initial postmortem for incident AC-2026-362 (approx. 2026-10-18 23:40 UTC). Our SREs asked whether Redwood can temporarily hold and grant access to the request-level logs and KV cache snapshots tied to account acme-health for the next 72 hours while we finish a deeper analysis.

Specifically we need:
- Request logs for the window 2026-10-18T23:30Z -> 2026-10-19T02:00Z
- KV cache snapshot for service starlite-acme (if available)

We understand this is an exception to your standard retention policy — please advise what you can hold, for how long, and any controls you need in place (audit, access restrictions).

Attached: incident_summary_AC-2026-362.pdf (summary + sample request ids).

Thanks,
Dana Miller
Director, IT Operations
Acme Health

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Incident AC-2026-362 - request to retain logs for debugging

Folks — forwarding Acme Health's request. They want a 72-hour hold on specific logs/snapshots for a debugging window.

Can Support and Security confirm feasibility and required guardrails?

Quick notes:
- Customer is explicit about narrow time window and is ok with limited scoped access.
- Attachment from customer is included (incident_summary_AC-2026-362.pdf).

If we can do this, I propose: 48-72 hour hold, access via Redteam support, access logged and limited to named engineers, and an automatic release at EOD 2026-10-22 unless extended with Security approval.

Rachel
Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: incident_summary_AC-2026-362.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Incident AC-2026-362 - request to retain logs for debugging

Thanks Rachel. Support can provision a temporary hold but we need to scope it tightly. Proposed scope:
- Only retain request logs and KV cache for account acme-health for the exact window Dana specified.
- No additional full request payload retention unless the customer signs a narrow waiver.
- Access: 2 named customer SREs + 2 Redwood on-call engineers; all access via ephemeral role that expires when the hold expires.
- Audit: enable audit logging for any downloads/queries against the held data.

I'll open OPS-1428 and prepare the hold record.

Question for Security: do we require redaction of PII before handing anything over to customer SREs? Also confirm whether a documented approval (DocuSign or internal approval link) is required.

Monica
Support Manager, Redwood Inference

Related: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-1428

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Incident AC-2026-362 - request to retain logs for debugging

Agree with Monica's scope. Security's conditions:
- Temporary hold permitted for the exact time window only. Hold will be implemented as an audit-scoped snapshot; no changes to retention settings globally.
- Access must be role-scoped, MFA enforced, and require just-in-time elevation with reason code. We will document the access in the security exceptions registry.
- Any PII must be redacted before export unless Acme provides a written data-processing justification and Legal signs off.
- We require a record (DocuSign or internal approval) mentioning purpose, list of named individuals, and a release date.

If Support will implement these controls we can approve a 72-hour hold that expires 2026-10-22T23:59:00Z unless renewed.

Vivek
Head of Security, Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Dana Miller <dana.miller@acme-health.com>, Kyle Turner <it-ops@acme-health.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Incident AC-2026-362 - temporary debug hold approved (conditions)

Dana / Kyle — thanks for the quick turnaround. Security has approved a scoped temporary hold with conditions. To confirm:
- Redwood will create an audit-scoped snapshot limited to account acme-health for 2026-10-18T23:30Z -> 2026-10-19T02:00Z.
- Access will be granted only to the two named Acme SREs you provide plus two Redwood engineers; access will be time-limited and fully audited.
- Any data exports that include potential PII will require written justification and Legal sign-off.
- The hold will automatically expire on 2026-10-22T23:59:00Z (UTC). If you need an extension, please reply with named approvers before that time.

Please sign the quick approval here so we can proceed: https://app.docusign.com/XYZ-approval-acme-hold

I'll loop in Support to create the hold and attach the internal record.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Customer Reliability Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: incident_summary_AC-2026-362.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Incident AC-2026-362 - temporary debug hold applied

All — final note: Support applied the hold and created an internal record. Details:
- Hold id: HOLD-AC-2026-362-01
- Snapshot: debug_snapshot_20261019.tar.gz (stored in secured bucket, KMS key redwood-prod-logs, access logged)
- Access: granted to Kyle Turner <it-ops@acme-health.com> and Dana Miller <dana.miller@acme-health.com> plus Redwood engineers (names recorded in registry).
- Release: hold scheduled to auto-delete at 2026-10-22T23:59:00Z (UTC) unless we receive an approved extension.

I've attached the hold record. Please follow the extension process in OPS-1428 if needed.

Monica
Support Manager, Redwood Inference
